title: justicia debilis
intro: Justicia debilis, commonly known as the "weak justicia" or "Indian trumpet", is a plant species in the Acanthaceae family. It is traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, which include lowering blood pressure, reducing inflammation, and alleviating respiratory issues. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to calm the nervous system, exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, and show antimicrobial activity. Bioactive constituents of Justicia debilis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoid glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
